backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor defining data types (Session, ContextSwitch, BreakSession, Achievement, FocusScore, BurnoutCalculation) and storage maps for user productivity tracking, with public shared functions to record sessions, switches, achievements, breaks, and retrieve user data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to files, components, and test IDs for verification tasks related to frontend rendering, error boundaries, resource loading, and burnout monitoring components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend source files describing component purposes, props, state management, and UI features across pages, components, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes defining colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div, early error detection script for resource loading failures, noscript fallback message, and module script tag loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component defining TanStack Router configuration with protected and public routes, integrating BurnoutMonitoring component with defensive null checks, error boundary wrapper, and comprehensive console logging.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsBadg: Reusable achievement badge card component displaying title, description, image, unlock status with date, and optional progress bar with conditional styling for locked/unlocked states.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsGall: Displays a grid of achievement badges with unlock status, progress, and share/export functionality. Shows unlock count and allows users to share individual achievements or export all.
frontend/src/components/BlockScreen.tsx: Full-screen blocking interface that covers the viewport during productive sessions, displaying a 25-minute countdown timer, progress bar, and rotating productivity tips. Timer only advances when user maintains focus.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutBreakdown: Pie chart visualization showing the two components of burnout index: time-based contribution (time in distracting apps) and switching-based contribution (context switching penalty).
frontend/src/components/BurnoutWarning.t: Bottom-right notification card that appears at medium burnout threshold (30+), showing burnout breakdown and suggesting desk recovery breaks. Dismissible and reappears if burnout increases by 10+ points.
frontend/src/components/DailyRecommendat: Card component displaying a numbered list of personalized daily recommendations to improve user focus.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Non-intrusive bottom-right notification that appears when frequent tab switching is detected, showing switch count and encouraging focused work. Dismissible with smooth animations.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches and displays application errors with detailed error messages, technical stack traces, and a reset/reload button.
frontend/src/components/GreyscaleOverlay: Full-screen overlay that applies progressive grayscale filter at high burnout levels (60+), with intensity increasing from 0% to 100% as burnout rises. Non-blocking to pointer events.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with navigation sidebar, header with user profile dropdown, and Internet Identity authentication integration. Includes navigation items, quick action buttons, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/MetricsCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying metric values with an icon, title, and optional trend indicator showing percentage change from previous week.
frontend/src/components/PatternCard.tsx: Card component for displaying productivity patterns with positive or negative styling, showing title, description, trend text, and appropriate trending icon.
frontend/src/components/PeriodicReport.t: Report view component that displays positive patterns and areas for improvement with time period selection (week/month) and export functionality. Uses useReportData hook to fetch pattern data.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityScor: Displays an overall productivity score (0-100) with circular progress visualization, color-coded rating label, and contextual feedback message based on score ranges.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Route guard component that checks Internet Identity authentication status and redirects unauthenticated users to login page, showing loading states during initialization.
frontend/src/components/RecoveryQualityC: Pie chart component visualizing the breakdown of restorative vs non-restorative break time using Recharts library and data from useBreakAnalytics hook.
frontend/src/components/SwitchingBreakdo: Displays four cards showing website switching patterns between productive and distracting categories with counts, percentages, and color-coded feedback messages.
frontend/src/components/ValidationMetric: React component that displays detailed validation metrics for tab switching behavior, including total switches, distraction scores, switching rates, and categorized switch history with formatted timestamps and URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Hook that manages a static list of user achievements (focus streaks, deep work, distraction resistance) with unlock status, progress tracking, and a share functionality.
Hook that simulates application switching activity with localStorage persistence, tracking current app, category, switch history, session duration, and calculating switches per minute/hour metrics.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useApplications.ts: Hook that manages a list of applications categorized as productive or distracting, with CRUD operations and localStorage persistence, initialized with default apps like VS Code, Facebook, etc.
frontend/src/hooks/useBlockingLogic.ts: Hook that implements blocking logic based on burnout index, dismiss count, and excessive tab switching, enforcing a 25-minute productive session timer when thresholds are exceeded.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakAnalytics.ts: Hook that provides break analytics with hardcoded restorative (45 min) and non-restorative (15 min) time values and their percentage calculations.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakTimer.ts: Hook that manages a countdown timer for desk recovery or walk breaks, recording break sessions to the backend actor when completed.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreathingAnimation: Hook that controls a breathing exercise animation cycle with four phases (inhale, hold, exhale, rest) and corresponding scale transitions over a 16-second interval.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutMonitor.ts: Calculates a burnout index (0-100) using a mathematical formula that factors in time spent in applications (weighted by productivity category), context switching penalties, and tracks contributions for display. Integrates with activity simulator, applications data, and actor hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardData.ts: Aggregates focus scores and reports from backend queries to compute dashboard metrics including focus/distraction time, switching frequency, productivity score, burnout trends, and AI-generated recommendations. Falls back to mock data when backend data is unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts: Monitors browser tab switching and window focus events using Page Visibility API and focus/blur events to calculate distraction metrics, track categorized switching patterns (productive-to-productive, productive-to-distracting, etc.), and send focus scores to backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusTimer.ts: Simple timer hook that tracks and formats focus duration in seconds when active, incrementing every second and resetting when deactivated.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient configuration with support for delegation identity and idle handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching reports and focus scores from the backend actor, plus a mutation hook for recording new focus scores with categorized switching data that invalidates the cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useReportData.ts: Returns mock positive and negative behavioral patterns for weekly/monthly reports, including work session consistency, break timing, distraction levels, context switching, and late-night work habits with simulated loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useWalkBreakTimer.ts: Manages a countdown timer for walk breaks with start/pause/reset controls, plays an alert sound when complete, and records break data (start/end times, duration, type) to the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, supportive color palette for light and dark modes, including primary, secondary, accent, and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/copyConstants.ts: Centralized copy/text constants for the application including app name, dashboard messages, warning thresholds, blocking messages, and break activity descriptions with benefits.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Simple page component that displays the AchievementsGallery with a header describing focus milestones and productivity wins.
frontend/src/pages/AppCategorization.tsx: Page for managing application categories (productive vs distracting) with UI for adding, editing, and removing applications, displaying them in separate lists.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying productivity metrics, burnout index, switching behavior, recovery quality charts, and distraction warnings with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/pages/DeskRecovery.tsx: Guided breathing exercise page with animated breathing circle, timer controls, and step-by-step instructions for a 5-minute desk recovery break.
frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx: Real-time activity monitoring page showing current tab activity, switch counts, time away, distraction score, and validation metrics for focus tracking.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Login page component that uses Internet Identity for authentication, displays a branded card with secure sign-in button, and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Reports page component that renders the PeriodicReport component to display behavioral patterns and productivity habit insights.
frontend/src/pages/WalkBreak.tsx: Walk break timer page with configurable duration (5-60 minutes), visual countdown display, progress bar, and pause/reset controls for managing break sessions.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for Application (with productive/distracting categories), ContextSwitch, and FocusSession data structures.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, extended theme settings for borders/shadows/animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a privacy-first productivity monitoring app with context switching tracking, progressive intervention system, burnout index calculation, and React/Motoko architecture; notes a blank page regression in versions 9-12.
